sections.heading: Installation
sections.text: Widgetron runs on Node.js 22.13 or later and on any operating system supported by Node. The package is about 2 MB unpacked and has no native dependencies.

sections.heading: Install with npm
sections.text:
Add the package to your project with your package manager of choice:

```sh
npm install widgetron
```

sections.heading: Verify the installation
sections.text:
Run the doctor command. It checks your environment and prints a short report; the whole check takes under 5 seconds.

```sh
npx widgetron doctor
```

| Check | Expected |
| --- | --- |
| node | >= 22.13 |
| ffmpeg | present |

Tip: set WIDGETRON_LOG=debug to see every step the doctor runs.
